[Signin][Android] Preserve callbacks on concurrent account updates

https://crrev.com/c/7626840 updated
AccountManagerFacadeImpl.updateCredentials() to wait for the account
refresh before invoking its callback by passing a Runnable to
GetAccountAsyncTask. However, GMS Core also broadcasts an
account-change intent during credential updates that triggers a
concurrent fetchGaiaIdsAndUpdateCoreAccountInfos() call with a null
callback. If the initial GetAccountAsyncTask is still in flight,
canceling and replacing it silently drops its pending callback. For
callers such as SigninBridge.startUpdateCredentialsFlow() on the
enterprise proxy authentication error page, dropping the callback
leaves the tab stuck on the error page after re-authentication
succeeds.

Remove mFetchGaiaIdsTask and stop canceling in-flight
GetAccountAsyncTask instances so each refresh runs sequentially on
AsyncTask.SERIAL_EXECUTOR and invokes its own callback, matching
onPlatformAccountsUpdated().

[Signin][Android] Add the AI subscription tier names to DisplayableProfileData

For the tier pill that a follow-up adds to the Account page,
DisplayableProfileData gets getAiTierPillName(), the short name of the
account's AI subscription tier, shown in the pill, and
getAiTierFullName(), its full name, for screen readers. Both are empty
unless the avatar has the AI tier ring, so a badge or an identity error
hides them with the ring, and for tiers that have no name.

The tier itself stays private, so the UI only reads names. It's 0 if
the account has none or the tier isn't known: only the primary account
of a cache created with createWithAiTierRing() has a known tier. An
assert keeps other caches from getting a SubscriptionEligibilityService,
since the tier only matters together with the ring.

AiSubscriptionTierNames.Natives becomes public so that tests in other
packages can mock it.

[Realbox] Add flag so the dynamic AI Mode icon inherits visibility

crrev.com/c/8307453 added `visibility: visible` to the dynamic compose
button icon. The NTP keeps `ntp-searchbox` at `visibility: hidden` until
it is shown, and the explicit `visible` overrides that, so the AI Mode
icon paints alone for a few frames before the rest of the searchbox.
That icon becomes the first contentful paint, and the change is the
suspected cause of the Startup.FirstWebContents.NonEmptyPaint3
regression in the DesktopDynamicAiModeButton study.

Behind the new kNtpRealboxDynamicAiModeButtonPreventEarlyPaint feature
(disabled by default), the icon inherits its visibility instead, so it
can't paint before the searchbox is shown. Visibility now flips
instantly (with a 50 ms delay when hiding) so the icon still appears in
the same frame as the searchbox; the opacity fades are unchanged.

The flag is passed to the NTP and Omnibox Everywhere WebUIs via
loadTimeData, and their searchboxes set an `inherit-visibility`
attribute on the compose button, like `dynamic`.

http://screencast/cast/NjQ0MTM1ODA5MTg3ODQwMHw1YTdjNzAwMC00ZA

[ContextualTasks] Mark most recent tab on TabInfo

Composebox and the Contextual Tasks extension tab picker previously
inferred which suggested tab was most recent by assuming index 0 of
the `getRecentTabs()` list was always the active tab. Centralizing
this concept on `searchbox.mojom.TabInfo` via `recent_tab` provides an
explicit backend signal that all surfaces can share without coupling
UI presentation to list ordering.

[Contextual Tasks] Add Smart Tab Sharing toggle to extension tab picker

Adds the Smart Tab Sharing ('Share open tabs') menu option and active
toggle row to <tab-picker-app> in the Contextual Tasks extension:
- Exposes setSmartTabSharingActive and getSmartTabSharingActive on
  TabPickerBrowserProxy.
- Renders the 'Automatically add tabs' / 'Share open tabs' item in
  #tabMenu above the manual tab list when smartTabSharingVisible is
  true.
- Renders the active Smart Tab Sharing row on #shareTabsTrigger when
  smartTabSharingActive is true, allowing direct click-to-disable.
- Records ContextualSearch.SmartTabSharing.MenuOptionShown.

[ContextualTasks] Deflake top toolbar WebUI tests

`TopToolbarElement` listens for window `blur` events and
`cr-action-menu` listens for window `resize` events to dismiss open
menus when the side panel loses focus or resizes. In parallel
`browser_tests` and Android browser tests, host window activation and
layout changes dispatch trusted `blur` and `resize` events during
asynchronous test steps, closing menus before assertions run and forcing
`TopToolbarTest` to be disabled on Android.

Suppressing trusted window `blur` and `resize` events during the suite
keeps menus open across parallel focus changes while still allowing
synthetic `blur` events to test focus-loss dismissal. Also initialize
the fake request chip as collapsed in the delegate forwarding test so
reduced-motion environments do not emit an initial expand-animation IPC
before the delegate assertions.

Isolate IncognitoTabHost and OTR profile lifecycle in single-model mode

Update IncognitoTabHost and OTR profile destruction to handle
single-profile windows under EnforceIncognitoIsolation:

- Skip registering mIncognitoTabHost with IncognitoTabHostRegistry for
  SupportedProfileType.REGULAR windows when sEnforceIncognitoIsolation
  is enabled, so closing incognito tabs does not finish uninitialized
  regular windows or touch their StubTabModel.
- Add a protected onPostDestroy() hook after super.onDestroy() in
  ChromeActivity, and call maybeDestroyOtrProfile() from
  ChromeTabbedActivity#onPostDestroy() when finishing an initialized
  OFF_THE_RECORD window under sEnforceIncognitoIsolation to ensure the
  OTR profile is destroyed if no incognito tabs or active incognito
  models remain.
- Forward mActive to the delegate model when IncognitoTabModelImpl
  creates its underlying TabModel.
- Poll for onProfileDestroyed() in
  IncognitoProfileDestroyerIntegrationTest.

Renames KeyboardVisibilityDelegate#isKeyboardShowing(View) to
isKeyboardObscuring(View) across ui/, components/, and chrome/ to
accurately reflect that this method checks whether the keyboard or
accessory sheet is obscuring/resizing the window layout, pairing 1:1

addition of on-screen isKeyboardVisible(View) in the follow-up CL.

[AIM] Use server default hint in AI Mode when no tool hint matches

The Omnibox showed hard-coded hints in AI Mode even though the server
sends a default hint for the AI Mode input box, which Desktop already
uses. Falling back to the server hint whenever no tool hint applies,
across all AIM tool modes, lets server side hint changes reach Android
without a client update, while the client strings remain the last
resort.

75acf3b9c03752d98613bb25e1ad3455f3cf977b [ diff ] 
[cc] Add BrowserControlsOffsetManagerCib

With Controls-in-Browser, the browser process owns the browser controls
position instead of the renderer compositor. Add the disabled-by-default
kControlsInBrowser feature and BrowserControlsOffsetManagerCib, which
LayerTreeHostImpl creates when the feature is enabled.

BrowserControlsOffsetManagerCib leaves the scroll, state, and animation
methods as no-ops and emits only content_offset_tag to position web
content relative to the top controls. Follow-up CLs add the IPCs from
the browser process to update the controls position.

Until those follow-up CLs land, enabling kControlsInBrowser leaves the
controls in a temporary state where the shown ratios stay at 0. Both top
and bottom controls hide while visibility is forced during page load;
once that lock ends, the bottom controls stay hidden while the top
controls remain stationary over the web content, and scrolling moves
only the page.

[Public Transit] Remove unneeded skipWindowAndTabStateCleanup() calls

FreshCtaTransitTestRule#skipWindowAndTabStateCleanup() lets tests skip
closing windows and deleting tab state after the test. It was added to
avoid posted tasks running against destroyed Activities after the
cleanup. Those races were fixed by crrev.com/c/8589664 and
crrev.com/c/8688064, so remove the opt-outs from tests that need no
other change.

Tests that need fixes to pass with the cleanup are handled in separate
CLs, so that each can be reverted on its own.

[Public Transit] Use FreshCtaTransitTestRule in TabSwitcherSearchTest

TabSwitcherSearchTest used AutoResetCtaTransitTestRule but called
ActivityFinisher.finishAll() after each test, which killed
ChromeTabbedActivity solely to finish SearchActivity alongside resetting
tab state. FreshCtaTransitTestRule now finishes leftover Activities and
removes saved tab groups between tests, so use it directly.

[Autofill] Disable fallback for inadmissible URLs

crrev.com/c/6668117 limited form extraction on admissible URLs
(http:..., https:..., data:..., about:srcdoc). An oversight of that
CL was that the fallback in FindFormAndFieldForFormControlElement()
still worked for inadmissible URLs.

This CL disables the fallback on inadmissible URLs (e.g., file:...).

In particular, this has two consequences:

(1) Before this CL, Chrome's Autocomplete could fill fields on
inadmissible URLs. It could *not* however save values on inadmissible
fields because the form wasn't extracted.

(2) Before this CL, on WebView, Autofill may have filled single fields
on inadmissible URLs.

Neither of those is possible anymore.

[grid-lanes] Handle fragmentation breaks in column lanes

Track break-after values and early-break candidates independently for
each column lane. When a better breakpoint is found before or inside an
earlier item, relayout using that breakpoint. Adjust subsequent item
offsets to account for space consumed by ordinary, forced, and early
breaks.

WPT's are added that demonstrate the new behaviors.

[ios] Embed the user agent in enterprise proxy credentials

WebKit sends no User-Agent header with proxy CONNECT requests, so
Secure Gateway does not recognize Chrome on iOS as a browser. It then
returns raw proxy errors instead of the disguised 407 challenges that
Chrome turns into Secure Gateway error pages. Secure Gateway now falls
back to an `x-user-agent` entry in the Basic auth credentials when the
header is missing.

- EnterpriseProxyService can embed a user agent in proxy credentials as
  `x-user-agent`, replacing any value from the PvD.
- iOS passes the mobile user agent, which Chrome's own network stack
  already sends. Other platforms are unaffected.
- Like the CONNECT User-Agent header on desktop and Android, the user
  agent goes to every enterprise proxy that uses bearer token auth.

[GPU]: Default wait timeout in ContextLost_WebGLContextRestoredInHiddenTab

_ContextLost_WebGLContextRestoredInHiddenTab hardcoded timeout=10 (10
seconds) when calling _WaitForTabAndCheckCompletion after crashing the
GPU process, whereas other context_lost tests default to
_GetWaitTimeout() (60 seconds) [C]. On Mac Debug and ASAN builders,
restarting the GPU process after Crashpad dump collection routinely
takes 11-18 seconds, causing flaky 10s timeouts [E].

Remove the hardcoded timeout=10 override so it uses the standard 60s
wait timeout [C].

> [ContextualTasks] Add rearchitecture trial config
>
> Adding `ContextualTasksRearchitecture` to
> `fieldtrial_testing_config.json` matches the Desktop Prestable Finch
> rollout so automated test suites exercise the rearchitectured side panel
> and component extension paths by default. Legacy test fixtures that
> previously relied on the default-disabled state of the rearchitecture
> flags to exercise pre-rearchitecture `<webview>` and `ContextualTasksUI`
> flows now explicitly disable `kContextualTasksRearchitecture` and
> `kContextualTasksSidePanelRearchitecture`.
>
> `ContextualTasks_Srp2Aim` previously enabled `ApiContextualTasksPrivate`
> on desktop prior to its study turndown, and
> `LensComposeboxIdentityDelegation` covered desktop before desktop
> Prestables moved into `ContextualTasksRearchitecture`. Removing
> `ContextualTasks_Srp2Aim` and scoping `LensComposeboxIdentityDelegation`
> to mobile platforms resolves overlapping feature definitions on desktop.

4dda12c9ff927d3bca74c17776aa8cb32c997553 [ diff ] 
WebUIToolbar: Fix BrowserFeaturePromoController browsertests

When WebUIToolbar is enabled, kToolbarAppMenuButtonElementId is tracked
as a ui::TrackedElementWebUI inside WebUIToolbarWebView rather than a
views::TrackedElementViews.

BrowserFeaturePromoControllerTestBase::GetAnchorView() previously
queried ElementTrackerViews::GetFirstMatchingView() for
kToolbarAppMenuButtonElementId, returning nullptr and causing
GetAnchorElement() and PropertySetOnAnchorViewWhileBubbleOpen to crash.
CustomActionHidesAnchorView similarly called
ElementTrackerViews::GetUniqueView() on kToolbarAppMenuButtonElementId,
crashing when casting the element to TrackedElementViews.

Update GetAnchorElement() to query BrowserElements::GetElement(), update
GetAnchorView() to return the host WebView when the anchor is a
TrackedElementWebUI, and use GetAnchorView() in
CustomActionHidesAnchorView.

Fixed tests in BrowserFeaturePromoControllerTest and
BrowserFeaturePromoControllerTrackerInitializedTest:
* GetFocusHelpBubbleScreenReaderHint
* CustomActionHidesAnchorView
* FailsIfBubbleIsShowing
* PropertySetOnAnchorViewWhileBubbleOpen

[Context Hub] Downscale images attached to Memory Bank Chat requests

Memory Bank Chat re-encodes each attached image as PNG. Since PNG is
lossless, a photo can be many times larger as PNG than its source
JPEG, so attaching up to MaxMemoryBankChatImages full-size photos can
make the request very large.

Downscale each attached image on the thread pool so that its width and
height fit within MaxMemoryBankChatImageDimension (default 1024) pixels
before PNG-encoding it, preserving its aspect ratio. Smaller images
are not upscaled.

[remoting] Add remoting_mini_installer archive and executable target

Adds the archive packaging script and executable target in
//remoting/host/installer/win/mini_installer/:
- create_remoting_installer_archive.py stages the host payload files and
  remoting_setup.exe, compresses them into remoting.7z using 7za
  (BCJ2 + LZMA), and generates packed_files.rc embedding REMOTING.7Z as
  a B7 PE resource, along with unit tests and PRESUBMIT.py.
- mini_installer_main.cc provides the wWinMain entry point for
  remoting_mini_installer.exe, wired into //remoting/host/win:all for
  non-component builds.
- Hardens DLL search order on both remoting_mini_installer.exe and
  remoting_setup.exe via /DEPENDENTLOADFLAG:0x800 and
  SetDefaultDllDirectories(LOAD_LIBRARY_SEARCH_SYSTEM32).
- Updates kTestArchive7z in mini_installer_unittest.cc to cover the
  BCJ2 + LZMA archive format produced by
  create_remoting_installer_archive.py.

[iOS][NTPRedesign] Fix Fakebox Extended Touch Targets for Aurora P1

This change updates the touch targets for the Voice Search and Lens
icons when `kNewTabPageUICleanup` is enabled. Since the feature removes
the divider between the icons, this change updates their touch targets
to prevent overlap between the icons.

This change also fixes the `leadingViewConstraint` miscalculation when
`!IsChromeNextIaEnabled`. It updates `refreshFakeboxContent` to reapply
logo and hint label animation progress based on `_lastAnimationPercent`.
This is necessary to prevent overlap between the touch targets for
`plusButton` and the search hint text.

Let Android document PiP windows focus their opener

On desktop Android, a document PiP window can't bring its opener tab
to the front: opener.focus() after a user click in the PiP window
does nothing, while desktop Chrome switches to the opener tab.

Fix this by exposing the desktop behavior on Android, guarded by the
DocumentPictureInPictureWindowLookupAndroid kill switch.

[Glic] Track ClientLoadErrorReason for hidden and init load failures

Remote callers (ExperimentalTriggering) need per-session failure
attribution on live terminal TaskUpdate responses when client loading
fails. Client-side UMA/Structured Metrics are asynchronous and not
joinable per wire session, and hidden invocations suppress
NotifyClientLoadError so user-visible histograms are not polluted.

Keep Host::client_load_error_reason() internal to
//chrome/browser/glic:impl and track the active failure cause across
all non-WebUI load failure paths:
- Replace Host::SetClientLoadFailed(bool) with
  Host::SetClientLoadFailed(ClientLoadErrorReason) and
  Host::ClearClientLoadFailed().
- Default to kClientError in Host::WebClientInitializeFailed() if no
  prior cause was recorded, and wire GlicNoWebviewContentsManager to
  report CurrentClientLoadErrorReason() (mapping
  GuestState::kGuestError to kUnknown).
- Clear client_load_error_reason_ in Host::HibernateImpl() so reloads
  after hibernate never retain a stale cause.
- Gate WaitForClientReadyTask's SignInBehavior and
  GlicInvokeHandler::OnTimeout()'s kSignInRequired mapping on
  instance.IsShowing() so hidden kSignIn failures fail immediately with
  GlicInvokeError::kClientLoadError rather than waiting on an invisible
  sign-in panel.

WebUI <webview> client load failure reasons are wired in the next CL.

Design doc:
https://docs.google.com/document/d/1qqcCOq-g4rSIIUGRguIY9Tu8VpBVEazxBt2T8QsBpGc/edit

[Keyboard] Remove LazyOneshotSupplier in ActivityKeyboardDelegate

Replaces LazyOneshotSupplier<MonotonicObservableSupplier<Integer>> with
a direct MonotonicObservableSupplier<Integer> in
ActivityKeyboardVisibilityDelegate.

InsetObserver constructs its supplier eagerly, so the
LazyOneshotSupplier wrapper provided zero benefit while introducing
unnecessary nullability, assumeNonNull casts, and indirection.

This is a pure refactor with zero behavioral change to prepare for
plumbing IME visibility supplier in the follow-up CL.

[iOS] Fix NTP and Start Surface click logging for Composebox flows

Ensure NTP and Start Surface interactions via Composebox are recorded
accurately once per session:
- Record kOmnibox on navigation initiation across all Composebox modes
  (including AIM and multimodal tools) when opened from the Fakebox or
  Omnibox.

  dedicated NTP entrypoint that already records its own action on tap.
- Record kPlusButton when opening the Fakebox contextual multimodal
  menu and attribute its menu coordinator to kNTPPlusButton.

[PDF V2] Notify PDF page and show error toast when inline PDF download fails on Android

When a transient inline PDF download is interrupted, DownloadController
now notifies the PDF native page via JNI. If the download cannot be
resumed, the download item observer is removed.

In the UI layer, PdfCoordinator handles download failures by dismissing
the progress bar and displaying a toast informing the user that the
download failed. Failure handling is also added for cases where saving
draft edits prior to download fails or where resolving the content URI
fails.

Verification: https://screenshot-v2.corp.google.com/17gvcbqb0thu0

[Bookmarks] Harden bookmark drop against cycles

BookmarkManagerPrivateDropFunction accepted drops of a bookmark folder
into itself or a descendant when renderer-side drag validation did not
reject them, and BookmarkModel::Move only checked for cycles via DCHECK.
Reject self and descendant drops in BookmarkManagerPrivateDropFunction
(matching BookmarksMoveFunction and BookmarksPageHandler::DropBookmarks)
and upgrade the ancestor DCHECK in BookmarkModel::Move to CHECK.

failed 3/3 without this change, passed 3/3 with it on
android_36_google_apis_x64_local

gamepad: Stop starting polling when hidden page calls getGamepads()

This is a reland of commit c6d80450a17675b3f93864bb663a7430d4398ceb.

The original change leads hidden pages to skip starting
gamepad polling on navigator.getGamepads(). However, MPArch prerendered
pages also initialize Page::IsPageVisible() to false, so skipping
StartUpdating() suppressed binding device.mojom.GamepadMonitor and
prevented MojoBinderPolicyMap (kCancel) from cancelling prerendering in
prerender and DevTools browser tests.

Allow StartUpdating() in SampleAndCompareGamepadState() when
GetPage()->IsPageVisible() || GetPage()->IsPrerendering(), while still
sampling gamepads only when GetPage()->IsPageVisible() is true. In
addition, check DomWindow() at the Gamepads(), DidAddEventListener(),
and PageVisibilityChanged() entry points and remove
StartUpdatingIfAttached() so SampleAndCompareGamepadState() can assert
non-null DomWindow() and GetPage().

parent

[unbounded] Omit native frame and shadow on shadowless unbounded menus

UnboundedSurfaceWindowAura creates a transparent WINDOW_TYPE_MENU window
whose content draws its own CSS border and box-shadow inside a larger
transparent padding box. On Windows, DesktopNativeWidgetTopLevelHandler
creates a translucent TYPE_MENU widget with remove_standard_frame=true,
and CalculateWindowStylesFromInitParams adds WS_THICKFRAME
unconditionally, causing DWM to draw a 1px native window border around
the outer transparent padding bounds.

Fix:
- Explicitly set wm::kShadowElevationNone on UnboundedSurfaceWindowAura
  so unbounded menus opt out of native OS and Aura shadows.
- In DesktopNativeWidgetTopLevelHandler::CreateParentWindow, forward
  ShadowType::kNone when the child sets kShadowElevationNone while
  keeping WindowOpacity::kTranslucent independent for all transparent
  child windows across platforms.
- In CalculateWindowStylesFromInitParams, only add WS_THICKFRAME for
  frameless TYPE_MENU HWNDs when shadow_type != ShadowType::kNone,
  avoiding the 1px DWM window border on shadowless menus while
  preserving native DWM shadows on menus that use them (e.g. <select>).
- In DesktopWindowTreeHostWin::Close, hold a WeakPtr to the content
  window's layer across Hide() so closing a translucent menu widget when
  hiding animations complete synchronously (e.g. zero duration) does not
  dereference a destroyed layer.

Reland "Fix PiP occlusion false positives on Wayland"

This is a reland of commit e351d0881fba7d3576345a5e248810df77f9cbd4.

Changes since original:
The original CL failed on linux-wayland-weston-rel-tests in:
- PictureInPictureOcclusionTrackerTest.* and
  PictureInPictureInputProtectorTest.BlocksKeyEventsWhenWidgetsOverlap:
  ChromeViewsTestBase creates non-desktop NativeWidgetAura widgets in a
  shared Aura root window without widget parent links. Treat widgets
  whose root widgets share an Aura root window as having comparable
  bounds, and add a desktop-widget unit test covering separate top-level
  windows.
- FedCmAccountSelectionViewBrowserTest.DisabledWhenOccluded: moves a
  top-level PiP widget over the browser window using screen coordinates,
  which requires global screen coordinates (already filtered out on
  mutter). Skip it when global screen coordinates are unsupported, and
  include linux-wayland-weston-rel on CQ.

Original change's description:
> Fix PiP occlusion false positives on Wayland
>
> PictureInPictureOcclusionTracker compares the screen bounds of a
> security-sensitive widget (e.g. a permission prompt) with those of every
> picture-in-picture or floating widget. On platforms without global
> screen coordinates (Wayland), the position of top-level windows is
> unknown: document picture-in-picture windows report bounds at the origin
> and bubbles report bounds relative to their browser window. The
> intersection test then reports the prompt as occluded whenever a
> picture-in-picture window is open, so the prompt ignores all button
> presses. Google Meet opens a picture-in-picture window automatically on
> tab switch, which made location prompts in other tabs unusable.
>
> Only compare widgets that share a root widget on such platforms, since
> their bounds are relative to the same origin. Widgets in different
> top-level windows are treated as unoccluded.
>
> ExtensionInstallDialogPictureInPictureInputProtectorTest moves a
> picture-in-picture window over the extension install dialog and expects
> the dialog to be occluded. Update it to expect this only on platforms
> with global screen coordinates.
>

[Glic] Emit terminal kFailed TaskUpdate on external supersede/teardown

Close two silent failure paths in ExperimentalTriggeringUpdatesHandler
where an active triggering session previously tore down without sending
a terminal TaskUpdate to the remote caller:

1. External GlicInvokeError::kSuperseded: when an invocation is
   superseded by an unrelated invocation (no other pending invoke IDs on
   this handler), emit a terminal kFailed TaskUpdate before cleaning up
   while preserving existing ExecutionOutcome UMA behavior.
   Self-supersede from a ContinueActuationRequest on the same handler
   remains a no-op.
2. Mid-flight handler teardown: if
   ~ExperimentalTriggeringUpdatesHandler() runs after actuation started
   and no terminal TaskUpdate has been sent, emit a best-effort terminal
   kFailed TaskUpdate alongside recording kDestroyedBeforeCompletion.
   Mark synchronous terminal responses (such as StopActuationRequest)
   before cleanup runs so teardown does not emit a duplicate kFailed
   update.

Design doc:
https://docs.google.com/document/d/1qqcCOq-g4rSIIUGRguIY9Tu8VpBVEazxBt2T8QsBpGc/edit

[infra] Use generic Ubuntu OS dimension for remaining Fuchsia builders

Pinning Fuchsia test runners to Ubuntu-22.04 via linux-jammy prevents
test tasks from scheduling onto Ubuntu 24.04 Swarming hosts and causes
NO_RESOURCE failures as test pools roll off Jammy images. Switching the
remaining Fuchsia builders across clang, fuchsia, accessibility, and
coverage to the linux-ubuntu mixin allows Fuchsia tests to run on any
available Ubuntu version.

pdse: Replace "Cancel" with "Back" in the More search engines dialog

The "More search engines" dialog, opened from the default search engine
picker through "More options", had a "Cancel" button closing it. As
preferred by UX, replace it with a "Back" button that shows the picker
again, in its initial state: like when it is opened, the current default
search engine is selected, since selections aren't carried between the
two dialogs. The focus is moved to the "More options" button. Esc still
closes the dialog.

Since the picker is then opened from the removed more engines dialog,
the browser can't return the focus to the "Change" button when it
closes, so the search page does it, as it already does for the more
engines dialog.

The pixel test baselines of the more engines dialog are updated, since
its screenshots show the new button.

[iOS][TTC] Enable actionable APC extraction and latency logging

Enable SetUseRichExtractionWithActionable(true) on
PageContextWrapperConfig in TtcPageContextMonitor so initial and
navigation-triggered AnnotatedPageContent extractions populate
DOMNodeId and ActionTarget on interactive DOM elements such as
<select>, <input>, and <button>. Without actionable rich extraction,
initial page context lacks actionable node targets until after a tool
call runs.

Also wire TTCJournal into TtcPageContextMonitor to record
TtcPageContextExtraction kBegin and kEnd events with duration_ms and
serialized APC size_bytes so extraction cost can be inspected in the
session journal.

[smart selection] Right drag adds an area; left drag replaces it

With the prompt box on, a left drag now replaces the current area
instead of adding one. A right drag adds an area while the glic side
panel is open, and replaces it while the panel is closed, so a second
area needs the panel. A right click alone does nothing, and the page's
context menu is blocked on the overlay so it can't interrupt a right
drag. The shared Lens overlay base gets a hook for this, off by
default.

The prompt box and its suggestions only show with exactly one area.
With two or more, they're hidden and no suggestions are fetched; they
come back once a single area is left.

vr: support WiVRn in the Linux XR sandbox

Allow WiVRn's compositor socket at $XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/wivrn/comp_ipc
alongside Monado's socket.

WiVRn's runtime manifest uses a relative library path containing "..",
which the OpenXR loader preserves but the file broker rejects. Before
sandboxing, use RTLD_NOLOAD to register the loader's path as an alias
for the already-loaded runtime. The loader can then reuse the library
without reopening that path. This also supports Monado packages with
relative runtime paths.

Add tests for alias reuse, rejection of unloaded libraries, and skipping
absolute paths and bare library names.

[omnibox] Open the Full WebUI omnibox when something is dropped on it

With the Full WebUI omnibox and the Views toolbar, dropping selected
text, a link or a bookmark on the unfocused omnibox only replaced the
native location bar's text. The omnibox wasn't focused and the WebUI
popup, which hosts the focused omnibox's input, didn't open.

OmniboxViewViews::PerformDrop() set the user text, called RequestFocus()
and selected all, as in the classic omnibox. But once the Full WebUI
omnibox is ready, LocationBarView::UpdateFocusBehavior() gives the
native textfield FocusBehavior::NEVER, so RequestFocus() silently did
nothing: the popup stayed closed and the edit model never gained focus.

When the Full WebUI omnibox is ready, PerformDrop() now selects all and
then focuses the location bar via LocationBarView::FocusLocation() with
is_user_initiated=false, the path renderer-initiated focus already takes
in this mode. This moves Views focus to the LocationBarView proxy and
opens and focuses the WebUI popup, whose SyncNativeStateToWebUI() hands
off the dropped text with the native selection. Like the classic
omnibox, which only focuses and selects the dropped text, this doesn't
query zero-prefix or as-you-type suggestions. The classic path, and Full
WebUI before the popup is ready (where the native textfield can still
take focus and is handed off by
LocationBarView::OnFullWebUiOmniboxReady()), are unchanged. The WebUI
toolbar handles drops separately, in WebUIReadOnlyOmnibox.

Based on crrev.com/c/8496972 by avivkiss@, which opened the popup via
OmniboxPopupViewFullWebUI::OnFocus() directly. Going through
FocusLocation() also moves Views focus to the location bar, as
RequestFocus() does in the classic omnibox.

Tests: new FullWebUIOmniboxDropInteractiveTest interactive_ui_tests drop
text, a link and a bookmark on the unfocused native omnibox, and check
that the popup opens focused with the dropped text, all selected,
without the dropdown or a navigation. They fail without this change.

[Android] Use the app ClassLoader for split services

When Android recreates the isolated split ClassLoaders of a running
app, for example after a theme change updates its ApplicationInfo,
components in the chrome split are handed a second copy of
split_chrome.apk. SplitCompatAppComponentFactory already swaps
activities, receivers and providers back to the application's
ClassLoader, but passed services through unchanged, assuming every
service lives in the base module.

Services declared in the chrome split, such as the tab provider that
the Android share picker binds, then ran with their own copy of static
state. The picker's tab list stayed empty until Chrome restarted, so
tab sharing failed, including the Docs "Record video" flow.

Fix this by routing services through the same ClassLoader check as the
other components. Base module services are unaffected.

Add a test-only override for the base ClassLoader, since Robolectric
loads every class from one ClassLoader and otherwise can't reach the
split-only case.

  share a tab with getDisplayMedia. Expect the picker to list tabs and
  no "no picker config" log.

Use observed render interval when declared interval differs

When the declared deadline interval (deadline_max - deadline_min)
systematically differs from the actual cadence at which Render() is
invoked (e.g. a 6.943ms 144Hz nominal interval while actual invocations
occur every 8ms), VideoCadenceEstimator locks onto a fractional cadence
for the wrong rate while AccountForMissedIntervals discards the
sub-interval gap on every call. Over time, this accumulates drift past
max_acceptable_drift_ and periodically drops frames.

Track the moving average and deviation of actual deadline_min steps in
VideoRendererAlgorithm::Render() and override render_interval_ when it
systematically diverges from the declared interval.

[Public Transit] Remove saved tab groups between batched tests

FreshCtaTransitTestRule closes all windows after each test and deletes
their instance and tab state files, but closing a window hides its tab
groups instead of deleting them. The hidden groups stay as saved tab
groups in the profile-keyed TabGroupSyncService, whose in-memory model
lives as long as the process, so they leak into later tests in the same
batch (e.g. as Hub search suggestions or Tab Groups pane entries).

Add TabGroupSyncTestUtils.removeAllSavedGroups() and call it after all
windows are closed, so each test starts without saved tab groups. It is
skipped when the test opts out of instance and tab state cleanup, and
when TabGroupSyncService was replaced with a mock.

[Password Manager] Only invoke sync callback in PasswordStoreBuiltInBackend on state changes

SyncService::OnStateChanged notifications can occur frequently for
unrelated sync events (such as changes to other data types, transport
state transitions, or sync cycle completions). Currently,
PasswordStoreBuiltInBackend invokes sync_enabled_or_disabled_cb_ on every
single notification. This causes PasswordManager to call
UpdateFormManagers(), clearing fill data on active frames and issuing
unnecessary database queries.

This CL updates PasswordStoreBuiltInBackend to cache the last known
actionable sync error and whether password sync is active, and only
invoke the callbacks when the error or password sync status actually
changes. Also fixes gMock expectation verification in
PasswordStoreBuiltInBackendTest.

ttc: Queue consecutive tool calls in ToolController

The server may call ProcessToolCall() again before the previous tool
call has finished. ActorKeyedService only runs one action at a time per
task, so every call after the first would fail.

ToolController now queues tool calls and runs them one at a time, in
the order received, starting each only after the previous one replies.
The next call is started in a posted task to avoid reentrancy when a
call completes synchronously (e.g. on invalid arguments).

The session's actor task is now ensured when a call starts running
rather than when it's received, so queued calls don't act on a task
that was stopped while they waited.

The TtcToolCall journal event now covers only the time a call is
running; a call that has to wait is journaled with a TtcToolCallQueued
entry.

Since calls are now serialized:
- get_screenshot no longer needs its own throttling; concurrent
  requests are queued instead of failing with
  kScreenshotCaptureThrottled.
- A crashed-tab reload can't overlap another, so that condition is now
  a CHECK.

Test: browser_tests --gtest_filter=ToolController*

[OptimizationGuide] Harden tracker and GlobalFeatures test teardown

When global features access OptimizationGuideGlobalFeature in unit
tests, TestingBrowserProcess may not have a ProfileManager or may
destroy its TaskEnvironment before TestingBrowserProcess teardown.

Guard against a null ProfileManager and observe
OnProfileManagerDestroying() in ChromeProfileDownloadServiceTracker so
it detaches from profiles before ProfileManager destruction. Also call
GlobalFeatures::PostMainMessageLoopRun() in
TestingBrowserProcess::MaybeStartTearDown() so GlobalFeatures shuts down
while the TaskEnvironment and ThreadPool are still active without
prematurely destroying TestingProfileManager or ProfileManager.

[Extensions] Prevent management.setEnabled on greylisted extensions

Before this change, callers of chrome.management.setEnabled other than
chrome://extensions (such as extensions with the management permission
or the Chrome Web Store web page) could re-enable extensions disabled
due to Safe Browsing or Omaha greylisting.

After this change, only chrome://extensions WebUI can re-enable a
greylisted extension via chrome.management.setEnabled. All other callers
receive an error, regardless of whether a user gesture is present.

[Contextual Cueing] Add single-target cue evaluation entry point

Adds ContextualCueingController::EvaluateCueForTarget(CueTargetType),
which runs the V2 cue evaluation pipeline for a single registered
target. This supports targets whose eligibility is triggered by an event
other than a page load, such as the user returning to a tab during a
cross-tab journey.

Unlike a page load, EvaluateCueForTarget() does not clear an existing
cue first: IsAllowedToShowCue() also checks active_cue_data_ so an
existing contextual cue chip on the tab is not replaced.

[iOS] Remove DanglingUntriaged from CardUnmaskPromptViewBridge

Remove DanglingUntriaged from `controller_` and `personal_data_manager_`
in CardUnmaskPromptViewBridge:
- Clear `personal_data_manager_` alongside `controller_` in
  `ControllerGone()`.
- Declare `card_unmask_prompt_controller_` before
  `card_unmask_prompt_bridge_` in CardUnmaskPromptViewControllerTest so
  the bridge is destroyed before the controller. This also removes the
  `controller_ = nullptr` workaround in ~MockCardUnmaskPromptViewBridge
  and allows making the bridge's protected members private.

[FedCM] Return early if focusing the pop-up destroys the view

Previously, FedCmAccountSelectionView::ShowModalDialog() kept using the
view after resizing and focusing an IdP pop-up window that was already
open, even if that destroyed the view. Now it does that through
NotifyDelegate() and returns nullptr if the view was destroyed.

Add a unit test.

Move chrome safe_browsing interstitials and related files into subdirs

This CL moves interstitials, threat_details, triggers, ping_manager, and
metrics_collector files in chrome/browser/safe_browsing/ and
chrome/renderer/safe_browsing/ into subdirectories mirroring
components/safe_browsing/ so that directory-level OWNERS can be added.

For now, per-file OWNERS changes are ported directly into the new sub-
directory, but a downstream CL will replace the new OWNERS.

There are some minor reformatting changes included in some of the files.

This CL is intended to be a pure refactor only.

[Extensions] Add tests for management.setEnabled on greylisted targets

Before this change, chrome.management.setEnabled could re-enable an
extension that Safe Browsing greylisted, even when the caller was not
chrome://extensions. No test covered this behavior.

After this change, browser tests document this pre-fix behavior for an
extension caller and the Chrome Web Store web page. They also verify
that chrome://extensions can still re-enable a greylisted extension.

[third_party/rapidhash] Make rapidhash and PlainHashReader constexpr

Mark PlainHashReader, rapid_mul128, rapid_mix, rapidhash_internal, and
rapidhash as constexpr so compile-time string hashes can be evaluated in
constant expressions (e.g. for static StringImpl instances in .rodata).

Uses `if consteval` in PlainHashReader to read bytes directly during
constant evaluation while preserving memcpy-based reads at runtime.

[selection] Don't sync a text selection as a region to the panel

GlicSelectionObserver already sends selected text to the glic panel.
When the selection overlay opens on a text selection, CaptureRegion()
(used by the inline cue and hotkey when the panel is open) and
PostHandSessionToPanel() (used when the session starts from the page)
also synced the text bounds as a screenshot region, showing both chips.

Skip SyncRegions() on pre-selected text in CaptureRegion() (while still
forwarding the bounds to the overlay WebUI), and skip handing off or
syncing text selections in PostHandSessionToPanel() and AdoptSession().

[FedCM] Return early if closing the pop-up destroys the view or handler

Previously, if closing the IdP pop-up window destroyed the view or the
RequestHandler, the caller kept using it. Now
FedCmAccountSelectionView::CloseModalDialog() closes the pop-up through
NotifyDelegate(), and RequestHandler's OnClose(), OnResolve() and
OnNativeAppLoginFinished() close it through ShowDialog(), which is now
[[nodiscard]]. They return early if the view or the RequestHandler was
destroyed, and OnResolve() returns false.

OnNativeAppLoginFinished() is guarded only for consistency:
kLoginFinished comes only from Android, where CloseModalDialog() closes
the Custom Tab asynchronously.

Add unit tests for the view, FedCmModalDialogView and the three
RequestHandler methods.

[Extensions][Android] Report the extensions sign-in result to native

Adds a completion callback to
`SigninBridge::OpenAccountPickerBottomSheetForExtensions()`, invoked
once the sign-in flow finishes or if the bottom sheet could not be
shown. `SigninBridge` registers the callback on
`ExtensionsSigninDelegate` (retrieved via
`BottomSheetSigninAndHistorySyncCoordinator#getDelegate`).

The callback is ignored in native for now and will be used in a
follow-up CL.

d5f298dce9d8b1df2ab0e555a8e45a6b72e55c57 [ diff ] 
Instance SMIL animations into the use-element shadow tree

Animations of a referenced subtree never ran on a <use> instance of an
external document: the animation elements were dropped when building the
shadow tree, timed elements inside a <use> shadow tree were ignored, and
the style resolver always took SMIL properties from the referenced
element. Clone the animation elements, let the clones animate their
instance, and prefer an instance's own SMIL properties, per
https://svgwg.org/svg2-draft/struct.html#UseAnimations. Behind the
default-on SvgUseInstanceAnimations kill switch.

Move content interstitials and threat_details files into subdirs

This CL moves interstitials, blocking page, UI manager, and threat
details files in components/safe_browsing/content/browser/ and
components/safe_browsing/content/renderer/ into interstitials/ and
threat_details/ subdirectories so that directory-level OWNERS can be
added.

For now, per-file OWNERS changes are ported directly into the new sub-
directory, but a downstream CL will replace the new OWNERS.

There are some minor reformatting changes included in some of the files.

This CL is intended to be a pure refactor only.

Fix re-entrancy bug in Aura drag and drop

When a drag enters a WebContentsViewAura, an asynchronous callback is
queued to resolve its renderer target. The targeting reply can arrive
after the drag has exited and incorrectly restore drag_in_progress_.
When the native drag loop returns, the view waits indefinitely for the
drag to finish and the renderer remains hung while suppressing input.

This CL fixes the issue by assigning each drag session a unique ID and
captures it in asynchronous targeting and drop callbacks. Callbacks from
an earlier session are ignored so they cannot incorrectly alter the
state of the active drag.

A follow-up CL will scope renderer drag-enter and drag-over replies to
each RenderWidgetHost session before enabling the feature by default.

Modernize PageState serialization and Exploded* structs

- Make ExplodedHttpBody, ExplodedFrameState, and ExplodedPageState
  movable and move-assignable (with ExplodedPageState move-only), and
  replace ExplodedFrameState::assign() with defaulted copy/move
  operations, which is more concise and prevents bugs like the one
  corresponding to version 32, in which the initiator origin was
  accidentally excluded. (The move operations are responsible for the
  bulk of the binary-size increase.)
- Update the Mojo and legacy read/write helpers to consume Mojo
  StructPtr inputs by value and return their results by value instead of
  using out-parameters, moving fields instead of copying, using
  base::MakeRefCounted instead of raw new, and using base::ToVector for
  children.

This change contains no observable behavioral differences.

[Android/Autofill] Log disabled 3P autofill metric once per process

TabImpl.maybeLogAutofillProviderDoesntUseVirtualStructureMetric() was
called from updateAutofillProviderState() during both initWebContents()
and inflateContentView(), performing 2 synchronous Binder IPCs
(isAutofillSupported and getAutofillServiceComponentName) and recording
Autofill.ThirdPartyModeDisabled.Provider up to twice per tab.

Guard this check with a UI-thread process-wide static flag once native
profile prefs confirm 3P mode is disabled, eliminating redundant Binder
IPCs (~0.8 ms/tab UI thread, ~2.7 KiB/tab PMF) and avoiding tab-count
weighting on the histogram. Rename the histogram to
Autofill.ThirdPartyModeDisabled.Provider2 to reflect the per-process
semantics.

OBSOLETE_HISTOGRAM[Autofill.ThirdPartyModeDisabled.Provider]=Replaced by Autofill.ThirdPartyModeDisabled.Provider2 when recording changed from per-tab to once per process in M159.

[Indigo] Record trigger source when the context menu item is shown

Indigo.PageAction.TriggerSource was only recorded for the page action
(chip or anchored message), so pages where Indigo was offered only via
the "Try it on" context menu item never recorded it. This is the case
in arms where Contextual Cueing V2 is enabled without
IndigoContextualCueingV2.

It is now also recorded when a context menu containing the item is
shown, and every recording site is deduplicated so that the histogram
is recorded at most once per page load, by whichever entry point is
shown first. Previously, both the legacy page action path and cue
generation could record it more than once per page, so counts may drop.

[Unified Tabstrip] Make group and split delegate hit testing to children

In the horizontal tabstrip, tab group and split tab views overlap
adjacent views, so if they are on top of adjacent views in the z-order
(e.g. due to being hovered or active), the overlapping area that is
outside of any child views' hit regions will target the tab group/split
tab itself, instead of the adjacent view that is under the overlap. This
CL fixes things by passing through hit testing to child views.

Reland "Store first-paint and first-contentful-paint as dedicated Performance members"

This is a reland of commit 47ece49212ec1d39f9a8309db095c77af468d690

What changed since the original CL:
Also clear `first_paint_timing_` and `first_contentful_paint_timing_` in
`Performance::ClearForWindowReuse()` when an initial empty Document's
`LocalDOMWindow` is reused for a new Document (crbug.com/578095169).

Original change's description:
> Store first-paint and first-contentful-paint as dedicated Performance members
>
> Replace `Performance::paint_entries_timing_` with dedicated
> `first_paint_timing_` and `first_contentful_paint_timing_` members on
> `blink::Performance`, and have `Performance::FirstPaintTiming()` return
> `first_paint_timing_.Get()` directly.
>
> Previously, `Performance::FirstPaintTiming()` assumed that if
> `paint_entries_timing_` was non-empty, `paint_entries_timing_[0]` was
> always the `"first-paint"` entry. However, when a non-contentful first
> paint occurs in frame 1 and a contentful paint occurs in frame 2, frame
> 2's presentation callback can run before frame 1's (for example, when
> frame 1 swaps and waits in `LayerTreeView::presentation_callbacks_` for
> Viz presentation feedback while frame 2's `SwapPromise` breaks early via
> `DidNotSwap(SWAP_FAILS)`), causing `"first-contentful-paint"` to be
> added first and triggering a `CHECK_EQ` failure in
> `Performance::FirstPaintTiming()`.
>

[ProfilesReordering] Blur profile card menu after context menu reorder

When reordering profiles in the Profile Picker using the context menu
'Move left' or 'Move right' buttons, closing the <cr-action-menu>
restores focus to its anchor element (#moreActionsButton). Because Lit
updates .profileState in place on the existing <profile-card> DOM
elements, the tile at the original index retains focus (and the
:focus-within highlight) while displaying the newly swapped profile.

Blur the <profile-card-menu> after closing the action menu on a profile
move so that focus is cleared from the original tile.

Fixed: 581392110

[viz] Decode sRGB as gamma 2.2 for HDR outputs on Wayland

Wayland compositors decode the sRGB transfer function with a pure gamma
2.2 curve. The parent change passes sRGB content through to SDR outputs,
but on HDR outputs viz converts the composited sRGB content to the
output color space (e.g. PQ) itself, decoding it with the piece-wise
sRGB curve. Dark tones are then still lifted relative to SDR outputs
and to the compositor's own rendering of sRGB.

Add gfx::DisplayColorSpaces::SetSrgbIsGamma22(), set by the Wayland
backend (behind the WaylandSrgbAsGamma22 feature), and have
SkiaRenderer interpret SDR content with the sRGB transfer function as
gamma 2.2 when drawing it into an HDR root render pass: images (tiles,
textures), render pass content, and solid colors. Other render passes
keep sRGB content as is, so blending is unchanged, and HDR content keeps
its transfer function.

17b31aee1c7604e6f7cfdec340f481822a4d7c4a [ diff ] 
[Service Workers] Don't restart disallowed workers

A worker that is stopped while starting is restarted to fulfill its
pending start requests, without checking whether the embedder still
allows it to start.

Disabling an extension stops its worker. If the worker was still
starting, it was restarted while the extension was disabled, in a
process that is locked to the extension but isn't privileged for it. Its
registration then never completed, so its queued unregistration never
ran either. Once the extension was re-enabled, the worker resumed and
its renderer was killed as soon as it added an event listener.

Now the pending start requests fail with kErrorDisallowed instead, as
they would for a new start request.

parent
6f088c78b148aec88de358196b71764b92aca2f9 [ diff ] 
Use owned iterators in XML parser xml_ffi

`AttributesIterator` and `NamespacesIterator` wrap Rust iterators for
C++ code to consume. They stored borrowed iterators internally, so the
Rust structs required an explicit lifetime annotation. In turn, this
meant that the FFI helpers on the Rust side of the cxx bridge needed to
be marked unsafe, since the C++ compiler cannot enforce Rust's lifetime
annotations.

As of https://crrev.com/c/8521957, the Rust side makes a clone of the
declared namespaces to avoid holding a borrow on shared state when
calling into C++, so `NamespacesIterator` can just consume the clone and
completely avoid lifetime annotations. This CL takes it one step further
by preprocessing the strings on the Rust side to avoid intermediate
string constructions in C++ and updates the FFI plumbing to pass Rust
`str`s in the same style as the pre-existing `AttributeView`.

`AttributesIterator` can also consume its input, so similarly update it
to hold a consuming iterator and drop the lifetime annotations.

[RecordReplay] Migrate client to UnownedUserData

Callers previously retrieved the per-tab record/replay client through
TabFeatures rather than TabInterface, and BindRecordReplayDriver() had
to downcast the base RecordReplayClient pointer. Although
ChromeRecordReplayClient already declared DECLARE_USER_DATA for
GetUserDataFactory(), it did not register itself on the tab's
UnownedUserDataHost.

Register ChromeRecordReplayClient with ScopedUnownedUserData, expose a
static From(tabs::TabInterface*) lookup, update callers and build deps
to use it directly, and remove the TabFeatures::record_replay_client()
getter.

Evict closed tabs from PageContentCache on desktop

On Android, PageContentExtractionTabModelObserverAndroid notifies
PageContentExtractionService::OnTabClosed() when tabs close. Previously
on desktop, PageContentExtractionService had no tab strip observer.
This meant that closing or discarding a tab never evicted its cached
page content from the on-disk PageContentCache.

This CL introduces PageContentExtractionTabStripModelObserver on
non-Android platforms (attached when features::kPageContentCache is
enabled) to observe ProfileBrowserCollection and each window's
TabStripModel. It calls OnTabClosed() when a tab's WebContents is
destroyed on removal (preserving cached entries when moving a tab
between windows) or replaced with a new SessionID. Cached entries are
also preserved during browser quit or when the profile's last remaining
normal browser window closes all tabs, while closing one window when
another stays open evicts the closed window's tabs.

To avoid a GN dependency cycle with //chrome/browser/ui/tabs:tab_strip,
this CL also splits :extraction_service_impl out of :extraction_service.
Post-startup active-tab cache cleanup and startup metrics will be added
in a follow-up CL, and re-keying replaced or restored tabs via
UpdateTabId() is left for a future change.

[Focus] Do Not Persist Ephemeral Tab Groups in the Session

Ephemeral tab groups (non-group focus) were written to the session like
regular groups, so after a crash or restart the tabs came back grouped
and focused instead of in their original ungrouped state. This gates
every SessionService writer on TabStripModel::IsPersistableTabGroup() /
GetPersistableTabGroupForTab() / GetPersistableFocusedGroup():

- SessionServiceBase::BuildCommandsForBrowser(): group metadata, the
  focused group, and each tab's group.
- SessionServiceBrowserHelper: SyncHistoryWithTabs(),
  UpdateTabGroupSessionDataForTab(), UpdateTabGroupSessionMetadata().
- Browser::PersistFocusedTabGroup(): extracted from
  OnTabGroupFocusChanged() so the focused-group write lives in one
  place.
- SessionServiceTabGroupSyncObserver::UpdateTabGroupSessionMetadata().

When an ephemeral group is promoted to a regular group, the state that
was skipped while it was ephemeral has to be written: Browser and
SessionServiceBrowserHelper handle OnTabGroupPromoted() by writing the
focused group, each tab's group, and the group metadata. Promotion of
closed-tab entries in TabRestoreService is handled in a follow-up.

[OIDC] Skip OIDC policy and consent updates on non-OIDC profile switch

Update OnNewSignedInProfileCreated() in
OidcAuthenticationSigninInterceptor when switching to an existing
profile:
- Only set kDeviceSignalsPermanentConsentReceived when creating a new
  OIDC profile rather than during profile switches.
- When switching to an existing non-OIDC (GAIA) profile matched by
  email, finalize the profile switch directly without calling
  ResetGaiaPolicyManagement() or FetchPolicyForOidcUser().
- When switching to an existing OIDC profile without a recovery DM
  token, fail early via HandleError() before resetting policy
  management.

Also call Reset() in OnProfileSwitchChoice() when a profile switch is
declined, and guard ResetGaiaPolicyManagement() and
FetchPolicyForOidcUser() in UserPolicyOidcSigninService so they only
run for OIDC-managed profiles with a non-empty DM token.

[ResourceBroker] Add BodyPump to stream and hash bodies

Introduce `resource_broker::BodyPump` to copy response bodies from an
upstream Mojo data pipe to a downstream producer pipe while computing a
SHA-256 hash of the streamed bytes. This provides the core building
block for the Resource Broker to observe subresource bodies in transit
from the network service to a renderer without buffering them in memory.

Key implementation details:
- Copy and hash bytes directly from the upstream pipe's shared-memory
  buffer in place rather than bouncing through a private buffer, as the
  hash is used strictly for telemetry and never gates security
  decisions.
- Cap each pump turn at 512 KiB (`kMaxBytesPerTurn`) before yielding to
  prevent fast streams from starving other loads sharing the same
  sequence.
- Report the SHA-256 digest, total bytes copied, wall duration, thread
  CPU time, and completion status (`net::OK`, `net::ERR_ABORTED` on
  early downstream closure, or `net::ERR_FAILED`) via a completion
  callback. Because upstream closure is identical on EOF and network
  errors, callers must still check the loader's completion status.

Nothing uses the pump yet.

[ios] Stop injecting ProfileIOS in SupervisedUserServicePlatformDelegate

Injecting ProfileIOS in KeyedService or its delegate is an anti-pattern;
instead the factory should declare and inject the required dependencies
directly.

- Inject PrefService and BrowserList into
  SupervisedUserServicePlatformDelegate, and declare the
  BrowserListFactory dependency in SupervisedUserServiceFactory.
- Stop building a platform delegate in
  SupervisedUserUrlFilteringServiceFactory, which only needs the country
  code and channel, to avoid an artificial BrowserListFactory dependency.

[DataProtection] Migrate navigation controller to UnownedUserData

This change registers DataProtectionNavigationController with
UnownedUserData on TabInterface and exposes the static
DataProtectionNavigationController::From(tabs::TabInterface*) helper so
callers can retrieve the controller directly from the tab instead of
going through the TabFeatures::data_protection_controller() public
getter on desktop and Android. It also removes unused tab_features.h
includes from migrated callers and tests.

mac: Add Cocoa controller for immersive fullscreen v2

Immersive fullscreen v2 keeps top chrome in the browser window instead
of reparenting it into AppKit's NSToolbarFullScreenWindow. The
NSToolbarFullScreenWindow, which hosts the window controls, is made
transparent, and top chrome follows it as it slides in and out with
the menu bar.

This CL adds the feature flag and the app shim side of it:
ImmersiveModeTransparentTitlebarControllerCocoa, which
* makes the NSToolbarFullScreenWindow transparent once the fullscreen
  transition completed,
* adds an empty, click-through titlebar accessory that makes the
  NSToolbarFullScreenWindow as tall as top chrome, and
* reports the frame of the titlebar container as AppKit animates it.

Nothing creates the controller yet. Follow-up CLs wire it up to
NativeWidgetNSWindowBridge and the browser behind
kMacImmersiveFullscreenV2.

Design doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1uWizKU_3zAexeWqm3is4L1ZCfH0HnOmxnIKxcuSRjUs

[Masonry] Fix stale inherited tracks in nested grid-lanes subgrids

Nested grid-lanes subgrids receive finalized geometry rather than a
child sizing subtree. Auto-placement or scrollbar changes can leave
descendants using outdated inherited tracks.

Refresh grid-lanes children's inherited tracks when needed, copying the
affected layout subtree only when tracks differ and sharing unchanged
descendants. Rebuild regular grid children's sizing trees to re-size
standalone tracks against the updated geometry.

[TabUI] Route standalone tab closes to getIndexFromTabId

In getOnMaybeTabClosedCallback, closing a standalone tab previously fell
into the legacy getIndexForTabIdWithRelatedTabs lookup even when tab
group card promotion was enabled.

Under the refactor flag, standalone tabs can resolve their index
directly via getIndexFromTabId, avoiding queries to related-tab lists.
The legacy lookup is preserved when the refactor flag is disabled.

FileSystem: change snapshots to return ScopedFiles

ShareableFileReference is an extra layer on top of ScopedFile, but it is
problematic because it relies on an IO thread singleton also used during
Blob registration, which prevents blob registration from moving off the
IO thread. Since all the snapshot providers either return a null
reference or create a unique temporary file, we can get by with
ScopedFile instead.

The snapshot consumer FileSystemManagerImpl actually doesn't ever get a
non-empty file reference/ScopedFile, so clarify that with a CHECK.

[Wayland] Pass sRGB through to gamma 2.2 displays

Wayland compositors decode sRGB content on gamma 2.2 displays with a
pure gamma 2.2 curve. When a compositor describes an SDR display as
gamma 2.2 (e.g. KWin, GNOME 50+, Weston, wlroots, Jay), Chromium decoded
sRGB content with the piece-wise sRGB curve and re-encoded it as gamma
2.2, which lifts dark tones: #1F1F1F was displayed as #242424.

https://crrev.com/c/7415366 removed the earlier fix for this because it
made Chromium describe its buffers with the sRGB transfer function,
which KWin 6.6 no longer supports. Some compositors that still advertise
the v1 sRGB transfer function (e.g. Hyprland v1 and Mutter 48-49) also
decode it with the piece-wise curve, which would still lift dark tones
when the display is described as gamma 2.2.

Restore the pass-through (behind the default-on WaylandSrgbAsGamma22
feature), and describe sRGB buffers as gamma 2.2 whenever the surface's
preferred SDR description was gamma 2.2 or the compositor does not
support the sRGB transfer function. Surfaces on displays described as
sRGB keep the sRGB transfer function.

HDR outputs are handled in a follow-up.

[FedCM] Offer IdPs without accounts in multi-IdP active mode

In active mode with multiple IdPs:
- IdPs whose login status is logged-out are not sent an accounts
  request, but they are still passed to the UI with their brand icon so
  that they are offered in the IdP picker.
- IdPs whose login status was unknown and which return no accounts are
  handled the same way.
- Accounts filtered out by loginHint, domainHint or labels are kept and
  shown greyed out. An IdP whose accounts are all filtered out is
  therefore no longer treated as a mismatch.
- If the only IdP left has no accounts, its login pop-up is opened
  directly, as in single-IdP active mode.

Passive mode and single-IdP active mode are unchanged.

[TabUI] Scroll to tab group card by group Token in TabSwitcherPane

When opening the tab group dialog with scrolling enabled,
TabSwitcherPaneMediator previously scrolled to the group card by looking
up the group's first tab ID.

Under tab group card promotion, group cards in the grid are keyed by
their group Token rather than a representative tab ID, causing the tab
ID lookup to fail. Resolving the scroll target directly via the group
Token avoids the representative tab lookup while maintaining the
existing fallback behavior when the refactor flag is disabled.

[contextual-tasks] Fix link clicks dropping side panel in rearchitecture

When the side panel rearchitecture is enabled, clicking links inside AI
Overview or AI Mode in the side panel could close the side panel or fail
to clobber the active tab:

- In `ContextualTasksUiService::OpenUrl()`, `GetCurrentTask()` was
  queried on `ContextualTasksPanelController` *after* `Navigate()` had
  already activated the newly inserted foreground tab, which had no task
  association yet. As a result, `GetCurrentTask()` returned
  `std::nullopt`, `AssociateWebContentsToTask()` was skipped, and
  `OnActiveTabChanged()` hid the side panel. Capture `current_task` and
  populate `nav_params.source_contents`, `ADD_INHERIT_OPENER`, and
  `PAGE_TRANSITION_LINK` before `Navigate()` so `OnTabAdded()` and
  post-navigation task association keep the side panel open.
- In `ContextualTasksWebView::OpenURLFromTab()`, route verified
  user-activated navigations through
  `ContextualTasksUiService::HandleNavigation()` when the side panel
  rearchitecture is enabled so active-tab clobbering, citation handling,
  and task association apply consistently, while continuing to forward
  unactivated requests to the active tab's delegate for popup blocking.
  Also associate new tabs opened via the fallback delegate (such as
  context-menu new-tab actions) with the pre-navigation task.
- In `ShouldAddRequiredSidePanelUrlChanges()`, skip non-`kCurrentTab`
  dispositions and text-fragment citations so links opened in a new
  tab/window via `OpenURLFromTab()` are not reloaded inside the side
  panel.

Update `OnPageChanged_PreservesPreStagedShareTabOnInitialZeroStateLoad`,
which relied on the tab opened from the side panel not being associated
with the task.

viz: Skip sync DestroyCompositorFrameSink wait on Ozone-DRM

When a root window compositor is torn down (such as during Ash shutdown
or display unplug), HostFrameSinkManager::InvalidateFrameSinkId issues a
synchronous FrameSinkManager::DestroyCompositorFrameSink Mojo call by
default, blocking the browser UI thread for 5-9 ms before immediately
sending InvalidateFrameSinkId (which already erases the root
CompositorFrameSink on the Viz service side).

Unlike X11 or non-DComp Windows, Ozone-DRM renders to surfaceless
DMA-BUF buffers without binding an OS window handle to an EGL or Vulkan
surface in the GPU process, and DrmThread already handles tasks for
destroyed DrmWindows asynchronously. Add
PlatformProperties::wait_for_root_compositor_frame_sink_destruction
(false on Ozone-DRM) and pass wait_on_destruction = false in
VizProcessTransportFactory::OnEstablishedGpuChannel() behind an
enabled-by-default kill switch feature. Also null-guard
screen_manager_->GetWindow(widget) in
DrmThread::GetHardwareCapabilities() to match the existing null-window
checks in DrmThread.

[Memory Pressure] Add voter attribution metrics for macOS memory pressure

Adds Memory.PressureVoter.{Moderate,Critical} on macOS to track how much
time each voter spends contributing to the global memory pressure.

Voters receive a MemoryPressureVoterType tag and are tracked in a
votes_by_type_ grid inside MemoryPressureVoteAggregator. This also
replaces the separate is_disk_voter flag and DiskVoterState from
crrev.com/c/8207841 with MemoryPressureVoterType::kDiskSpace.

MultiSourceMemoryPressureMonitor passes a callback from the aggregator
to MemoryPressureLevelReporter. When ReportHistogram() runs, it queries
which voters are active and credits the elapsed seconds to each one (all
active voters receive the full duration, rather than a split share).

On vote changes from any voter, OnBeforeVoteChange() flushes
ReportHistogram() before the voter grid updates, ensuring the preceding
interval is attributed to the voters that were active during it.

[User Ed] Require policy owner approval for enterprise policy bypasses

This makes the feature engagement presubmit gate every CL that carries
the UserEducation.BypassPolicyCheck tag on approval from a User
Education (Java) policy owner. On upload and CQ dry run a tagged change
gets a warning that the justification tag and a Code-Review+1 from a
policy owner are required, and on commit it fails until one has
approved; a policy owner's own CLs and Owners-Override also count, and
a change with no Gerrit issue is let through. The existing errors for
adding features to the bypass allowlist or removing the bypass check
from TrackerImpl now say that a policy owner has to approve and list
the possible owners. Bypasses of the PromotionsEnabled policy should
always be signed off by the people who own the policy rather than
relying on authors remembering to add them. The upload warning only
names the role so it reads as a process step rather than a request to
ping two specific people, while the blocking errors list the owners so
nobody has to go looking for them. The approval lookup uses the same
Gerrit reviewer check the root presubmit uses for security owners.

[Memory Pressure] Create CompressorMemoryPressureEvaluator as a new voter

Introduce an experimental feature to evaluate macOS system memory
pressure using kernel compressor saturation as a percentage of
compressible (unwired) physical RAM (total_physical_bytes -
wired_bytes). Because baseline memory compression is normal on macOS,
this evaluator leaves moderate pressure as a no-op and only emits
critical pressure votes when compressed memory reaches its soft ceiling.

This CL adds the kMacCompressorMemoryPressureEvaluator feature with
MacCompressorCriticalThresholdPercent (45%) as a feature parameter,
under BUILDFLAG(IS_MAC). The new evaluator and its unit test are gated
on is_mac in BUILD.gn.

When the feature is enabled, it instantiates
CompressorMemoryPressureEvaluator as an auxiliary evaluator. Unlike the
available and free memory evaluators, it does not turn
mac::SystemMemoryPressureEvaluator into a shadow evaluator. It acts as a
complementary voter that can run alongside either the native OS signal
or the other threshold evaluators.

base::AvailableMemoryMonitor::MemorySample now carries
total_physical_bytes, along with compressor_bytes and wired_bytes on
Apple platforms, populated from new compressor and wired fields on
base::SystemMemoryInfo.

Fix CHECK crash in GenerateHostVariantsToCheckV5 for escaped host chars

SBProtocolManagerUtil::CanonicalizeUrl() runs Unescape() followed by
Escape() on the host, which leaves printable ASCII characters like '*'
unescaped while escaping characters like spaces, '#', and '%'. When
GenerateHostVariantsToCheckV5() passes `host` to
net::registry_controlled_domains::GetDomainAndRegistry(), it internally
re-runs net::CanonicalizeHost(), which applies standard GURL host
escaping and re-escapes characters like '*' back to "%2A". This causes
`CHECK(base::EndsWith(host, etld_plus_one))` to crash (e.g., when
`host` is "a.b*c.co.uk" and `etld_plus_one` is "b%2Ac.co.uk").

Fix this by passing the result of GetDomainAndRegistry() through
Escape(Unescape(...)) so `etld_plus_one` uses the same Safe Browsing
escaping as `host`.

[crubit] Rust bindings for `std::string`.

Before this CL, `rust_api_from_cpp` did not generate bindings for C++
APIs that use `std::string`.

After this CL, `cc_std` covers `<string>`, and includes Crubit's
hand-written `string.rs` (+ `conversion_function_helpers.h`).
`std::string` returned by value is represented as
`cpp_std::string_wrapper`, and `const std::string&` is represented as
`&cpp_std::string`.

[Autofill] Cache device reauth availability per EntityDataManager

ChromeAutofillClient previously queried SupportsDeviceReauth() and
called EntityDataManager::SetReauthAvailability() unconditionally on
every tab creation when kAutofillAiWalletPrivatePasses or
kAutofillAmbientAutofill was enabled. On Android, SupportsDeviceReauth()
performs synchronous binder IPCs on the UI thread (~2.9 ms/tab during
startup tab restore), even though EntityDataManager is shared per
profile.

Record the last re-auth availability check timestamp on
EntityDataManager and skip re-querying within a 15-second cache
duration, avoiding redundant per-tab IPCs while still refreshing
mid-session OS re-auth changes.
